sample_unit: brochures (6 bariatric procedures x 2 AI tools)

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated bariatric surgery patient brochures (Flesch-Kincaid)
links.effect: Both ChatGPT and Gemini produced content at approximately college-level readability, higher than ideal for the average patient, with limited accessibility for lower-literacy individuals.
links.quote: Despite these structural differences, both tools produced content with similar readability levels - approximately college-level - and comparable reliability scores.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient brochures relative to appropriate patient reading level
links.effect: Both tools generated patient information at approximately college reading level, with limited accessibility for individuals with lower literacy.
links.quote: Overall, both tools generated patient information of good reliability but with limited accessibility for individuals with lower literacy.

unlisted_practices: Human editing and simplification of AI-generated patient brochures before use

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, text overlap, and reliability (DISCERN) of patient education brochures generated by ChatGPT and Gemini for bariatric surgery without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
